question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a silver present, Claire has a gold present, Dave has a pink present, Eve has a green present, Fred has a purple present, and Gertrude has a grey present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Gertrude and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) silver present
(C) gold present
(D) pink present
(E) green present
(F) purple present
(G) grey present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: black, silver, gold, pink, green, purple, grey
1. Gertrude ↔ Fred: black, silver, gold, pink, green, grey, purple
2. Claire ↔ Alice: gold, silver, black, pink, green, grey, purple
3. Claire ↔ Bob: gold, black, silver, pink, green, grey, purple
4. Dave ↔ Eve: gold, black, silver, green, pink, grey, purple
5. Bob ↔ Alice: black, gold, silver, green, pink, grey, purple
6. Fred ↔ Claire: black, gold, grey, green, pink, silver, purple
7. Fred ↔ Bob: black, silver, grey, green, pink, gold, purple
Bob has the silver present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
